rules.statement: The decree for sale, to which section 9 of the Partition Ordinance, 1863, assigns a conclusive effect, is the original order for sale and not the certificate of Court mentioned in section 8.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not see how the certificate of title can be regarded as the decree for sale to which section 9 refers. That it is not so is clear from the language of section 8, which speaks of '.the certificate ' under the hand of the Judge that the property has been sold ' under the order ' of the Court."
